DOC-ARCH-001.document: GridFlow AI Architecture Specification: The GridFlow execution grid consists of four primary autonomous nodes: Planner_Node, Researcher_Node, Executor_Node, and Reviewer_Node, plus a deterministic Fallback_Handler circuit breaker. Planner_Node decomposes user goals into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of SubTasks. Researcher_Node queries gridflow_core_knowledge in ChromaDB with cosine similarity >= 0.72. Executor_Node synthesizes production Python code and artifacts in ./workspace/outputs/. Reviewer_Node validates syntax and security via AST parsing and enforces max_iterations = 3.

metadata.title: GridFlow AI Multi-Agent Cyclic Topology & LangGraph Orchestration

DOC-ARCH-002.document: GridFlow AI Memory Architecture (memory.md): Tier 1 is Short-Term Graph State (GridState TypedDict) with operator.add reducer for append-only execution_logs and merge_artifacts custom reducer for isolated artifact storage. Tier 2 is Episodic Session Persistence using SQLite checkpoints keyed by thread_id at every node boundary for fault recovery, state replay, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) inspection. Tier 3 is Long-Term Semantic Memory in ChromaDB storing verified code artifacts and summaries.

DOC-API-001.document: GridFlow Skill Registry & Security Policy (skill.md): 1. chromadb_semantic_search (Researcher_Node): Queries ChromaDB with cosine similarity >= 0.72. 2. web_scraper_extracter (Researcher_Node): BeautifulSoup live documentation extractor with 10s timeout. 3. python_ast_validator (Executor_Node, Reviewer_Node): Parses Python AST via ast.parse, flags banned calls (eval, exec, compile) and banned modules (subprocess, shutil). 4. artifact_file_writer (Executor_Node): Writes verified files jailed to ./workspace/outputs/.
